eps.ov: An herbivore's murder unsettles Cherryton Academy, with some suspecting grey wolf Legoshi. Dwarf rabbit Haru struggles with her classmates' bullying.
eps.oa: مقتل حيوان عاشب يقلق أكاديمية «تشيريتون»، ويشك بعضهم في الذئب الرمادي «ليغوشي». وتعاني الأرنبة القزمة «هارو» تنمر زميلاتها.

eps.ov: Legoshi ponders his own ferocious impulses; an altercation at breakfast unsettles him further. The theater students prepare for their play.
eps.oa: يتأمل «ليغوشي» نزعاته الضارية، ثم تزيد مشاجرة على الفطور اضطرابه. ويستعد طلاب المسرح لعرضهم.

eps.ov: Haru and Legoshi's interaction ends extremely awkwardly. With two days to the performance, the school newspaper is sniffing out what Louis is hiding.
eps.oa: ينتهي تفاعل «هارو» و«ليغوشي» بحرج شديد. وقبل العرض بيومين تتقصى صحيفة المدرسة ما يخفيه «لويس».

eps.ov: The drama club switches up parts after the last performance. Tapped to appear onstage, Legoshi confronts the new lead actor about a dangerous issue.
eps.oa: يبدّل نادي المسرح الأدوار بعد العرض الأخير. ويُختار «ليغوشي» ليظهر على المسرح، فيواجه الممثل الرئيسي الجديد في أمر خطر.

eps.ov: Legoshi deals with misplaced notoriety after the chaotic but successful play, with Jack's support. Haru and Louis have a clandestine encounter.
eps.oa: يتعامل «ليغوشي»، بسند من «جاك»، مع شهرة في غير موضعها بعد العرض الفوضوي الناجح. ويلتقي «هارو» و«لويس» لقاءً سرياً.

eps.ov: After another murder, herbivores are confined to campus. Out in town, the theater club carnivores enter a shady district for adult meat eaters.
eps.oa: بعد جريمة قتل أخرى يُحصر العاشبون داخل الحرم. وفي المدينة يدخل اللاحمون من نادي المسرح حياً مريباً لآكلي اللحوم البالغين.

eps.ov: The mystery of Legoshi's favorite lunch is solved. Haru recalls her first encounter with a vulnerable Louis, who has a fiancée.

eps.t: Caught Like Floss in a Canine's Teeth
eps.ov: Legoshi offers to escort Haru home; on the way she attempts to become better friends with him, unaware of his guilt. Juno has a revelation.
Louis recalls his harrowing past, and Legoshi makes a personal vow despite conflicting feelings. Meanwhile, Haru is kidnapped for ransom by carnivores.
Legoshi risks his life to find the Shishi-Gumi. A friend helps him channel and control his inner beast so that he can save Haru.
A ferocious Legoshi wreaks havoc to save Haru, while an unknown ally assists in their escape. Awkward timing causes some awkward situations afterward.
Haru and Legoshi return to school after their strange night. As the festival gets underway, Juno challenges Haru for Legoshi's affections.
